positions.name: AnalyticsDbMigrationTarget
positions.frame: what database platform is the analytics pipeline migrating to?
positions.why: src-1 states the migration from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB in prose; src-3 restates it as a bullet-point summary. Both cohere under the directional read of which platform the analytics pipeline is moving to — one as declaration, one as structured restatement.

positions.name: MigrationPerformanceJustification
positions.frame: what performance outcomes does the database migration target?
positions.why: src-2 asserts 10x query performance and lower licensing cost in prose; src-4 restates the 10x analytical query gain as a bullet. Both cohere under the read of what performance improvement justifies the migration — the same claim in two registers.
